review_notes: CVE-2026-84607: NVD's explicit iPhone OS CPE upper bound below 26.7 supports the reported 26.6.1 version being within the listed affected range; exact build 23G83 and exploitability remain unverified.
CVE-2026-43689: secondary public advisory record reports affected versions unknown; do not treat release ordering as precise version evidence.
CVE-2026-86876 and CVE-2026-86886: Apple/NVD summaries confirm impact and fix release, but this review did not capture a precise CPE range for either.
For all candidates, public affected-version evidence does not establish exploitability, a usable primitive, or a jailbreak chain.

2026-10-23 follow-up: public CVE records provide explicit iOS/iPadOS <26.7 range evidence for CVE-2026-43684 and CVE-2026-43686; NVD explicitly lists iPhone OS/iPadOS <26.7 for CVE-2026-84523. These are version-range matches only, not exact-build or exploitability confirmations.
CVE-2026-65405: secondary public record corroborates the 26.7 fix and impact, but exact NVD affected-software configuration still needs capture.
The search pass did not obtain reliable exact NVD CPE output for CVE-2026-84566, CVE-2026-84622, CVE-2026-28968, or CVE-2026-86886; these remain unresolved rather than inferred from release timing.

2026-10-23 NVD configuration capture pass: secondary public pages reproduce NVD CPE configuration details for CVE-2026-84566, CVE-2026-84622, CVE-2026-28968, CVE-2026-65405, and CVE-2026-86886. The iPhone OS/iPadOS entries include upper bounds below 26.7; several records also list a separate <27 range. This is captured as secondary representation, not a direct NVD API response; exact build and exploitability remain unverified.

audit_summary.result: Secondary public representations of NVD configurations captured for CVE-2026-84566, CVE-2026-84622, CVE-2026-28968, CVE-2026-65405 and CVE-2026-86886. iPhone OS/iPadOS CPE ranges below 26.7 are reported for these records; direct NVD API payload and exact build verification remain outstanding. No exploitability demonstrated.
